ssr.ui-layer-static-bypass.note: True ratio sits near 1.0; both sides take the same bypass path. Measured over 8 idle-machine runs at 40 samples: mean 0.97, sd 0.03, so 1.3 is roughly 12 sd out.

ssr.app-static-bypass.note: Was 1.5, which CI exceeded at 1.55 on a change that cannot reach this path. Spread here comes from between-run drift rather than within-run variance, so more samples does not shrink it: mean 1.14, sd 0.10, worst local run 1.38. 2.0 still catches a genuine doubling, and the 10000ns absolute budget above carries 12x headroom against the ~780ns observed median.
